title: Body mechanisms of the ported MetaWorm body (data/worm/ledger/metaworm_mechanisms.json)

mechanisms.name: 3D tetrahedral body (984 vertices, 3341 tets), MetaWorm mesh
elastic tissue: corotated linear FEM, one homogeneous material
mechanisms.notes: E inside the literature range if SI; Poisson 0.4; no cuticle / muscle / pseudocoelom layers

mechanisms.name: body-wall muscles: 96 linear fibre segments in 4 quadrants
mechanisms.notes: 95 Cook muscles + one extra (MVL24); no force-length or force-velocity

mechanisms.name: inertia: mass 10 over the 0.63-unit body, numerical damping
mechanisms.notes: density 19x a worm if read as SI; metre-scale world

mechanisms.name: fluid: quadratic drag and lift per surface triangle
mechanisms.notes: inertial regime (Re ~7,300) vs a worm's 0.1-0.5; viscous resistive-force drag is the literature replacement (needs implicit drag in the solver)

mechanisms.name: drive source
mechanisms.notes: closed loop with brain.py runs (src/wormemu/body/loop.py, pipe mode; 5 Nov: 3 s, bounded, drive 4.4e-6 so the body does not move)

mechanisms.name: proprioceptive outputs to the brain (curvature, rate, strain)
mechanisms.notes: curvature and its rate at 49 points streamed to the brain every exchange (loop.py); strain, contact and nose force sent as 0

mechanisms.name: numerics: projective dynamics, 240 Hz, 50 iterations
mechanisms.notes: published exit returns the iterate before the converged solve: drive below ~0.05 does not move a body at rest (BODY_TESTS.md); 'latest' keeps the converged solve, not yet adopted

mechanisms.name: chemical gradient scene (BAAIWorm chemotaxis)
mechanisms.notes: field sampled at the nose and tail (src/wormemu/body/scene.py); no plate physics yet (MB6); values in docs/worm/research/CHEMOTAXIS_PLATE.md

mechanisms.name: pharynx, egg-laying and defecation body parts
mechanisms.notes: the interface carries their activations; the body has no parts for them yet
